name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
description: Immediate support for individuals experiencing mental health-related distress, suicidal thoughts, or emotional crisis. Callers speak with trained specialists equipped to provide non-judgmental crisis intervention, safety planning, and warm transfers to local emergency psychiatric services.

name: Crisis Text Line
description: A non-profit network providing high-speed text-based emotional support. Users are connected with empathetic, certified crisis counselors within minutes to de-escalate acute panic, severe loneliness, depressive episodes, and interpersonal crisis through structured active listening.

name: The Trevor Project
description: The leading national provider of suicide prevention and affirmative crisis intervention for lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer, and questioning (LGBTQ+) young people under 25. Accessible via encrypted phone, text, and secure browser terminals.

name: International Helplines Directory (Befrienders Worldwide & IASP)
description: A federated directory maintaining vetted emotional support helplines across Latin America, Africa, Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Middle East. Facilitated in concert with the International Association for Suicide Prevention (IASP) to support SDG 3 target health outcomes.
